notes: kb/Work PB369. Rule text (cite.py --check 14.9.16.3 "the report description entry in which data-name-1 is specified and the file description entry associated with that report description entry shall contain a GLOBAL clause" -> OK, SR 3). Both halves hold. The RD half by construction: only a GLOBAL report of a container is visible to a contained program (DataBinder.VisibleReports), so a group of a non-GLOBAL one does not resolve and the GENERATE is refused COBOL1757 (negative/pb369-contained-generate-non-global-report). The FD half: RejectContainedReportFile, the one check the four verb rules share, refuses a GLOBAL report whose FD is not GLOBAL with COBOL2392. retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Reports.cs#InheritGlobalReport (kb/Work PB2357 split DataBinder.Reports.cs: the same code, unchanged, now lives in ReportSectionBinder.cs (the binder), ReportModel.cs (the model types) and ReportScope.cs (the visible-report lookups))
